posts.title: JSON-Server Basics
posts.description: is a lightweight tool used to create mock APIs quickly. It allows developers to simulate backend behavior without building a real server. This is extremely useful during frontend development and testing. It supports CRUD operations out of the box. JSON-Server helps speed up development workflows.

posts.title: Working with Mock APIs
posts.description: Mock APIs help frontend developers work independently from backend teams. Using tools like JSON-Server, developers can define data using simple JSON files. These APIs behave like real REST services. This improves productivity and parallel development. Mock APIs are widely used in modern web projects.
